tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read the account that owns this API key, including plan, limits, today's usage, and the prepaid credit balance in USD.

tools.name: list_shows
tools.description: List this account's daily podcast show. An account has at most one show.

tools.name: get_show
tools.description: Get one daily podcast show by id.

tools.name: create_show
tools.description: Create this account's daily podcast show from X accounts and topics. Fails if a show already exists. Language defaults to English. Free accounts stay English only and can follow 3 accounts. Pro can follow 25. Nora is the free voice. Leo, Kristine, Ken, and Marko need Pro for the daily show. This doe

tools.name: update_show
tools.description: Replace the daily show's name, X accounts, topics, language, voice, timezone, and delivery time. The same plan limits as create apply. topic_apply fills accounts from topics up to the Free or Pro cap. This does not change the subscription.

tools.name: generate_episode
tools.description: Start today's episode for this show. Uses the same Free and Pro rules as the website: one episode per delivery day, the same deleted-day tombstone, and the same pipeline. Free is one episode a day. This does not debit prepaid credits. Poll get_episode with the returned id. discard_script drops the s

tools.name: delete_episode
tools.description: Delete one daily episode the same way the website Library does. The row stays as a tombstone, the script is cleared, and the audio file is removed. That delivery day is not generated again, except for the website's admin reopen of the same row. An episode that is not this account's returns the same

tools.name: list_episodes
tools.description: List recent daily episodes for this account, newest delivery date first. This does not generate an episode. Use generate_episode to start today's episode.

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: Get one daily episode, including its script when one was saved.

tools.name: get_episode_audio
tools.description: Get a temporary MP3 URL for a ready daily episode. The URL expires in six hours. Audio past the retention window returns 410.

tools.name: estimate_script_audio
tools.description: Price a script without creating a job or spending credits. Voices are Nora, Leo, Kristine, Ken, and Marko. Output language defaults to English. The audio has no intro or outro.

tools.name: create_script_audio_job
tools.description: Debit prepaid credits and queue audio for a script. The price matches estimate_script_audio. A low balance returns 402. Pass idempotency_key to retry without a second debit. Set confirm_another when you mean to pay for another job. A 409 script_audio_active includes job_id and job_url. The message s

tools.name: list_script_audio_jobs
tools.description: List Script to audio jobs for this account. Queued and generating jobs are included, with in_progress true, so you can see the job that blocks a new create.

tools.name: get_script_audio_job
tools.description: Get one Script to audio job, including progress and estimated seconds remaining.

tools.name: get_script_audio_download
tools.description: Get a temporary MP3 URL for a ready Script to audio job.
